13. 2. 52.
Proposed arrival to Japan of Michel D.Shikis, alias Shikis de Shik, Greek citizen of Russian Jewish origin subject of several Shanghai Municipal Police files.

Information has been received from old acquaintances of Michel D.
Shikis, alias Shikis de Shik, Greek subject of Russian Jewish origin at present residing at Palestine that he has intention to proceed to Japan travelling on Greek passport.

M.D.Shikis resided at Far East since 1910 to 1917 according to his own statement to S.M.P made in 1928 he was engaged in smuggling drugs between Shanghai and Harbin. In 1917 he lost all his property on account of the Russian revolution which to a certain extent caused him to cease his smuggling activities. From 1922 to 1925 he was employed by the "Luminious Advertising Coy" in French Concession. In 1925 Shikis was found to be suffering from Bronhial trouble and was ordered to live in Harbin. At the end of 1927 Shikis arrived to Shanghai and was for a period unemployed residing at Savoy Hotel, Broadway

On April 14, 1928 M.Shik was introduced to Detective Inspt Robinson of C.I.D branch of Shanghai Municipal Police by Dr Kendler late director of Luminious Advertising Coy" where for a period was employed M.Shik. M.Shik proposed to work as informer stating ,that he could supply information re smuggling being engaged in this business himself 10 years ago. He claimed also to give information on foreign crooks engaged in counterfeiting banknotes of local banks, so all foreign gambling houses in the Settlement and persons concerned; on the working of opium and drug smugglers and the persons concerned and the present system of arms smuggling.

M.Shikis provided certain information later to C.I.D. branch of S.M.P among information was one of a valuable character re means of discovering the formula for the conversion of Benzoicum compounds into morphine and heroin which is useful in event a seizures are made.

Work of M.Shikis was treated very confidentially and was known to most of detectives.

关于米歇尔·D·希基斯（Michel D.Shikis），又名希基斯·德·希克（Shikis de Shik），希腊公民，俄裔犹太人，系上海公共租界工部局警务处多份档案涉及对象，拟抵达日本一事。

据目前居住在巴勒斯坦的米歇尔·D·希基斯（又名希基斯·德·希克）的旧识提供情报，该人为希腊籍臣民，俄裔犹太人，有意持希腊护照前往日本。

据米歇尔·D·希基斯本人于1928年向上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）陈述，他自1910年至1917年间居住在远东，从事上海与哈尔滨之间的毒品走私活动。1917年，因俄国革命，他失去了所有财产，这在一定程度上导致他停止了走私活动。1922年至1925年，他受雇于法租界的“光明广告公司”（Luminious Advertising Coy）。1925年，希基斯被发现患有支气管疾病，被责令居住于哈尔滨。1927年底，希基斯抵达上海，一度失业，居住在百老汇路的萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel）。

1928年4月14日，M·希克经“光明广告公司”前经理肯德勒博士（Dr Kendler）介绍，结识了上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事侦缉处（C.I.D.）的罗宾逊侦探督察（Detective Inspt Robinson）。M·希克提议担任线人，声称由于他十年前曾从事此行业，可提供有关走私的情报。他还声称能提供有关伪造本地银行钞票的外国罪犯、租界内所有外国赌馆及相关人员、鸦片及毒品走私贩及其相关人员，以及当前武器走私体系的情报。

随后，M·希基斯向上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事侦缉处提供了一些情报，其中包含一项具有价值的情报，即发现将苯甲酸化合物转化为吗啡和海洛因的配方之方法，这在查获案件时将派上用场。

M·希基斯的工作受到高度保密处理，仅为大多数侦探所知。

Later M.Shikis started to work as a Lawyer.For a period he was employed as
assistant of Paul Fremet, French lawyer of quite doubtful reputation.In 1935
M.Shikis acted as a spokesman for P.Fremet who was lawyer of Joseph Walden,
alias Maxim Rivosh alias Abramow who was also known as Mr X,prominent agent
of Comintern.

M.Shikis being in Shanghai during last years of his residence there was
known as ardent leader of "Seven Day Adventists" In this connection it should
be noted,that on December °,1936 in the Russian daily"Novy Put" appeared artic-
-le attacking confraternity of The Seventh Day Adventist led by a russian law
yer named M.Shikis.

Regarding Shikis it was mentioned the following:
"The service was conducted by ..... Mr Shikis. This caused an
enormous surprise. It would seem that there can be nothing in com-
-mon between Mr.Shikis and ignorant fanatics who think that they are
living saints. An incredible paradox; Mr.Shikis,a well educated
person,in the role of a leader of religious confraternity.
He said,"tolerantly blue" and possessing a very"unspiritual
face Mr Shikis did not look like a living saint...
....Their(Adventists, ) tendencies towards Judaism of Talmud and
what is most important,is calculated to undermine the normal state
of human mind by the fear if sudden catastrophe of the universe...
....However,this sect would not attract much attention,if,apart from
the features of religious nature,it did not possess features of po-
litical interest. The activities of the Adventist are definitely
disintegrating and anti nationalist character....

Neither M.Shikis nor religious confraternity concerned did not take
any steps in connectionwith above article.

After termination of the Pacific war M.Shikis in 194    left to
Palestine obviously as a person of Jewish origin altough of "Seven Day Adven-
tist" religion. It is said that in Palestine M.Shikis continued his religious
activity but difficult business condition in Izrael State forced him to take
steps to return to Far East well known to him where he has numerous old con-
nections.
In case of M.Shikis arrival if approached confidentially by the
proper authorities he could supply information regarding many former resi-
dents of Shanghai and North China now residing in Japan.

后来，M·希基斯开始从事律师工作。有一段时间，他受雇于保罗·弗雷梅特（Paul Fremet），一位声誉颇受质疑的法国律师，担任其助手。1935年，M·希基斯担任P·弗雷梅特的发言人，而弗雷梅特是约瑟夫·瓦尔登（Joseph Walden）的律师；瓦尔登又名马克西姆·里沃什（Maxim Rivosh），又名阿布拉莫夫（Abramow），也被称为X先生，是共产国际的一名重要代理人。

在希基斯居住在上海的最后几年里，他以“基督复临安息日会”（Seven Day Adventists）的热心领袖而闻名。在此方面值得注意的是，1936年12月[日期不清]，俄文日报《新路》（Novy Put）刊登了一篇文章，攻击由一名名为M·希基斯的俄国律师领导的基督复临安息日会教友团。

关于希基斯，文中提到以下内容：
“礼拜仪式由……希基斯先生主持。这引起了巨大的惊讶。看来，希基斯先生与那些自以为是在世圣徒的无知狂热分子之间没有任何共同之处。这是一个令人难以置信的悖论：受过良好教育的希基斯先生，竟扮演宗教教友团领袖的角色。
他说着‘温和的蓝色’[原文如此，可能指语调或态度]，长着一张非常‘缺乏灵性’的脸，希基斯先生看起来不像是在世圣徒……
……他们（安息日会信徒）倾向于塔木德犹太教，而最重要的是，这种倾向旨在通过宇宙突然灾难的恐惧来破坏人类心智的正常状态……
……然而，如果除了宗教性质外，该教派不具备政治利益的特征，它就不会引起太多关注。安息日会信徒的活动 definitely 具有瓦解性和反民族主义性质……”

无论是M·希基斯还是相关的宗教教友团，均未就上述文章采取任何行动。

太平洋战争结束后，M·希基斯于194[年份不清]年离开前往巴勒斯坦，显然是因为其犹太裔身份，尽管他信奉“基督复临安息日会”。据说，希基斯在巴勒斯坦继续其宗教活动，但以色列国的艰难商业状况迫使他采取措施返回他熟知的远东地区，他在那里拥有众多旧关系。

如果希基斯抵达后得到有关当局的秘密接触，他可以提供有关许多原上海及华北居民（现居日本）的情报。

In reference to the attached reports and
information given from time to time on
various matters by Mr. Shikis de Shik I am
of the opinion that his services have been
disappointing. In all cases where he has
laid information every possible assistance
and encouragement has been given him
by members of the Foreign Section to
obtain successful results but in almost
every instance certain essential details
of intelligence have been lacking which
undoubtedly prevented the C.I.D from
taking action. De Shik undoubtedly
knows many of the arms and drug
smuggling element in Shanghai but
his knowledge of them seems to be
confined to the outside edge of their
activities. Like most of the "reformed"
suspected criminals he is invariably
anxious to know the amount of reward
payable in the event of arrest or seizure
and like most informers is under the
impression that the C.I.D. have unlimited
funds. He has, however, given valuable
information in providing the C.I.D
with the means of discovering the
formula for the conversion of Benzoinum
compounds into morphine and heroin
which will prove useful in the event
of seizures being made. For this service
he has been well paid, having received
in all about $200.00, and I suggest
that he be informed that he cannot
be given any guarantee of employment
or remuneration but will be paid

Director of Criminal Intelligence,

REPORTED MANUFACTURE OF MORPHINE IN SHANGHAI

The nature of the process on the demonstration Sunday as stated
to Mr Jepheott, is as follows :-

" 8 grams of Material 'A' is dissolved in 60 cc of water
containing 3.5 grams of sodium hydrate ( caustic soda)
and the solution allowed to stand for 24 hours. 10 grams
of material 'B' is then added and the mixture well shaken
and allowed to stand a further 24 hours. Morphine is
precipitated and is separated and treated with dilute
hydrochloric acid to form the hydrochloride."

Mr Jepheott was able to obtain specimens of the materials and
also to show me the interacting mixture as made by the interested
agents and the results of my examination are :

Material 'A' - the basic material of the whole process - is a benzoyl
derivative of morphine, actually benzoyl-morphine hydrochloride. This
material must be produced originally from morphine and as there is no
evidence of its being used for medicinal purposes, the presumption is
that its production on any scale must be intended for the ultimate
regeneration of the parent substance - morphine.

The mechanism of the process is quite simple. The treat-
ment of the solution with caustic soda results in the elimination of the
benzoyl group with the reformation of morphine, which remains in solut-

致刑事情报处处长：

关于在上海制造吗啡的报告

周日演示过程中向杰普科特（Jepheott）先生所述的工序性质如下：-

“将8克‘A’物料溶解于含有3.5克氢氧化钠（苛性钠）的60立方厘米水中，
让溶液静置24小时。随后加入10克‘B’物料，充分摇匀混合物，
再静置24小时。吗啡沉淀析出，分离后用稀盐酸处理以形成盐酸盐。”

杰普科特先生得以获取这些物料的样本，
并向展示了由相关代理人制作的反应混合物，我的检验结果如下：

物料‘A’——整个工序的基础原料——是吗啡的苯甲酰衍生物，
实际上是苯甲酰吗啡盐酸盐。该物料最初必须由吗啡生产，
由于没有证据表明其用于医疗目的，因此推测，
任何规模的生产其最终目的必然是为了再生母体物质——吗啡。

该工序的机制相当简单。用苛性钠处理溶液会导致
苯甲酰基团消除，重新形成吗啡，后者以可溶性吗啡钠化合物的形式保留在溶

page_data.en:

ion as the soluble sodium compound of morphine. The addition of an
ammonium salt or even of bicarbonate of soda will then result in the
precipitation of free morphine which is separated and then treated with
dilute hydrochloric acid in order to form the soluble hydrochloride of
morphine.
Material 'B' was apparently sodium bicarbonate so far as my tests
went. The specimen which Mr Jephcott obtained had to be used for the
completion of the process. It is not of much moment, however, as the
base of the whole process is the Material 'A'.
The finished product brought by Mr Jephcott was morphine hydro-
chloride and reacted in the ordinary way to all the usual tests for
morphine hydrochloride.
The chemical properties of the benzoyl-morphine hydrochloride
differ considerably from those of morphine hydrochloride but the ident-
ification of the material is not difficult in a laboratory accustomed
to deal with narcotics.
J.G.C. Walker
F.I.C.
Chief Analyst.
